name: Port Conflict Check
description: Checks for port conflicts on common development ports at session start, warning if ports are already in use
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Check for port conflicts on common dev ports
PORTS=${CLAUDE_CHECK_PORTS:-"3000 3001 4000 5173 5174 8000 8080 8888 9000"}
CONFLICTS=0
for PORT in $PORTS; do
  if lsof -i :$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PROC=$(lsof -i :$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN -t 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    PNAME=$(ps -p "$PROC" -o comm= 2>/dev/null)
    echo "Port $PORT is in use by $PNAME (PID: $PROC)"
    CONFLICTS=$((CONFLICTS + 1))
  fi
done
if [[ $CONFLICTS -gt 0 ]]; then
  echo "$CONFLICTS port(s) already in use. You may need to stop existing servers."
fi
exit 0
